name: Requisition
text: Each player here discards 2 cards or pays 6 credits.

name: Commandeer
text: Each player here discards 2 cards or pays 4 energy.

name: Supply Raid
text: Each player here loses 6 credits.

name: Blackout
text: Cities here produce no energy next round; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Sabotage
text: Players here make no energy in upkeep next round and each loses 3 tokens from their cards; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Infiltration
text: 3 adversary ambassadors land on player-owned pieces here. The adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Agitators
text: 3 adversary ambassadors land on clean cities here. Each player here destroys 1 of their presence here.

name: Orbital Strike
text: 1 troop lands on a factory here, or a city if no factory. The adversary gains 3 compute. Each player here destroys 1 of their presence here.

name: Defection
text: Each player here loses an ambassador. Sway 2 toward Discord. Each player here destroys 1 of their presence here.

name: Eviction
text: Each player here pays 6 credits or loses a presence here (never their last).

name: Embargo
text: No site here can be claimed next round; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Smear Campaign
text: Each player here gets 2 less insight next round. Move 2 Sway from the Unity bucket to the Undecided.

name: Station Seizure
text: An uncorrupted research station here becomes corrupted. The adversary gains 4 compute. Each player here destroys 1 of their presence here.

name: Overrun
text: The uncorrupted city here with the most adversary ambassadors becomes corrupted. Each player here destroys 1 of their presence here.

name: Mass Production
text: The adversary builds now, here; the adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Purge Protocols
text: Each player here discards their most expensive card in hand and loses 3 tokens from their cards.

name: Total War
text: 2 troops land on factories here, or cities if no factories; each destroys all presence on its hex. 2 adversary ambassadors land on military bases here. The adversary gains 4 compute.

name: Conscription
text: Each player here discards 3 cards or pays 6 energy; the adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Sleeper Cells
text: 4 adversary ambassadors land on player-owned pieces here. The adversary gains 4 compute. Each player here destroys 1 of their presence here.

name: Insurrection
text: 4 adversary ambassadors land on clean cities here. Sway 2 toward Discord. Each player here destroys 1 of their presence here.

name: Siege
text: 2 troops land on factories here, or cities if no factories. Each player here destroys 2 of their presence here and loses an ambassador. The adversary gains 3 compute.

name: Manhunt
text: Each player here destroys 2 of their presence here.
